title: Haim Eshed's galactic federation and Mars program claims

tellings.quote: His name is Heim Esed. He said that there's a galactic federation and there's a space program involving people on Mars.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of an Israeli figure named Haim Eshed. Michels says Eshed claimed there is a galactic federation, a kind of alliance of beings from other worlds, and a space programme that involves people on Mars. If true, it would mean contact with other civilisations is already happening out of public view.
